scripts.worker:debug: cargo build --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml -p ai-worker && bun scripts/copy-worker.mjs debug
scripts.worker:release: cargo build --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml --release -p ai-worker && bun scripts/copy-worker.mjs release
scripts.build: bun run worker:release && vue-tsc -b && vite build && bun scripts/prepare-dist-manifest.mjs && bun scripts/verify-dist.mjs
